title: Complex-valued Phase-Coherent Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.22415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex-valued Transformers have inherited softmax attention over the raw complex inner product. Outside natively complex domains this standard form stays near chance, and no complex attention had been shown to correct it. We show that the match must be a scaled cosine score: L2-normalise queries and keys, so the score reads their cosine similarity and ignores their magnitudes, and hold that score at order-one scale. With this the same models train on four diagnostic tasks under two different gates; without the normalisation they stay at chance on ListOps and Needle under both gates and fall far below on the other two, and a normalised score placed at too small a scale fails as well. translated_abstract: 复数值Transformer一直沿用基于原始复数内积的softmax注意力机制。在天然复数域之外，这种标准形式的表现接近随机水平，且此前尚无任何复数注意力机制被证明能够纠正这一问题。我们证明正确的匹配方式必须是经过缩放的余弦分数：对查询和键进行L2归一化，使分数读取它们的余弦相似度而忽略其模长，并将该分数保持在一阶量级的尺度上。据此，相同的模型在两种不同的门控机制下均能在四个诊断任务上成功训练；若去掉归一化，模型在两种门控下于ListOps和Needle任务上都停留在随机水平，在另外两个任务上的表现也远低于正常水平，而归一化分数若置于过小的尺度上同样会失败。由此得到的相位相干Transformer（PCT）系列模型，在长程记忆、位置检索、层级推理、频域分类以及物理复数信号等任务上达到或超越了最强的实数值基线；它没有表现出……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现复数Transformer的标准内积注意力在非天然复数域上接近随机水平，并提出将注意力分数改为基于L2归一化查询与键的、保持在一阶尺度的缩放余弦分数，由此构建的相位相干Transformer（PCT）在长程记忆、层级推理、频域分类等多种任务上达到或超越最强实数值基线。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that raw complex inner-product softmax attention stays near chance outside natively complex domains, and proposes Phase-Coherent Transformers (PCT) that use a scaled cosine score—L2-normalised queries and keys held at order-one scale—matching or exceeding the strongest real-valued baselines across long-range memory, hierarchical reasoning, and frequency-domain classification tasks.
